DynaMix

DynaMix replaces the recurrent mixing/agent backbone in QMIX-style value factorization with alternative sequence models — a Transformer and a Structured State-Space Model (SSM) — and benchmarks them against standard cooperative and competitive MARL baselines across three environment suites: **Hanabi**, **MPE**, and **SMAX (SMACv1 + SMACv2)**.

## Algorithms | Family | Algorithms | |---|---| | Value-based | IQL, VDN, QMIX-RNN, QMIX-Transformer, QMIX-SSM, SHAQ | | Policy-gradient | IPPO, MAPPO (feed-forward & RNN variants) | ## Installation **Docker (recommended)** ```bash git clone cd DynaMix docker build -t dynamix . docker run --gpus all -it -v $(pwd):/workspace dynamix ``` **Manual** ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt --ignore-installed blinker pip install jaxmarl==0.1.0 --no-deps pip install --force-reinstall --no-cache-dir "jax[cuda12]==0.9.0" jaxlib==0.9.0 ``` ## Usage All experiments are configured with [Hydra](https://hydra.cc/). Configs live under each algorithm's `config/` folder. **Value-based (`QLearning/`)** — `iql.py`, `vdn.py`, and `qmix_rnn.py` share one config per environment; switch environments with `--config-name`: ```bash python QLearning/iql.py --config-name=mpe python QLearning/vdn.py --config-name=smax python QLearning/qmix_rnn.py --config-name=hanabi ``` `shaq.py`, `qmix_transf.py`, and `qmix_ssm.py` use their own dedicated configs (`*_shaq`, `*_transf`, `*_ssm`): ```bash python QLearning/shaq.py --config-name=mpe_shaq python QLearning/qmix_transf.py --config-name=hanabi_transf python QLearning/qmix_ssm.py --config-name=smax_ssm ``` **Policy-gradient (`PPO/`)** — one script per environment/backbone, run directly: ```bash python PPO/Hanabi/ippo_rnn_hanabi.py python PPO/MPE/mappo_ff_mpe.py python PPO/SMAX/mappo_rnn_smax.py ``` Any config field can be overridden from the CLI: ```bash python QLearning/iql.py --config-name=mpe LR=0.001 SEED=1 ``` ## Results ### Hanabi

## Project Structure ``` DynaMix/ ├── Dockerfile ├── requirements.txt ├── assets/ # framework diagram & result figures ├── PPO/ │ ├── Hanabi/ # ippo/mappo (RNN) + config/ │ ├── MPE/ # ippo/mappo (FF & RNN) + config/ │ └── SMAX/ # ippo/mappo (RNN) + config/ └── QLearning/ ├── iql.py / vdn.py / qmix_rnn.py / qmix_transf.py / qmix_ssm.py / shaq.py ├── config/ # per-env, per-variant Hydra configs └── utils/ # rollout manager, fast attention, SSM utils ``` ## Acknowledgements Built on top of [JaxMARL](https://github.com/FLAIROx/JaxMARL) for JAX-native multi-agent environments and baseline implementations. ## License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
